# Generated One Star faction paint

These project-created texture swatches are object-space paints for downloaded STL/3MF meshes that contain no UV coordinates or authored material data. They were generated with the built-in image-generation tool using the licensed Down Range miniature textures as palette and pattern-density references.

## LPM Field Camo Texture

- Workspace asset: `Assets/Resources/Models/OneStar/LPM Field Camo Texture.png`
- SHA-256: `D89BDC3CF0569763792DAD3740FC733CD351FDA927AE35921140ACAE67DB772F`
- Reference: `PLANMC Rifleman Texture.png`
- Prompt summary: Seamless matte tabletop-miniature camouflage using muted olive, dusty khaki, sage, charcoal-brown, and sparse brick-red recognition flecks; flat albedo with no lighting, objects, text, or national pattern.

## USMC Field Camo Texture

- Workspace asset: `Assets/Resources/Models/OneStar/USMC Field Camo Texture.png`
- SHA-256: `05F13B160B45EE6C1FB3AC776E657B7A56BB8F13AEF2C561FC6465B9DE0AAB5B`
- Reference: `USMC Rifleman Texture.png`
- Prompt summary: Seamless matte tabletop-miniature digital camouflage using coyote tan, sage olive, warm khaki, dark desaturated brown, and restrained dusty blue-gray recognition flecks; flat albedo with no lighting, objects, text, or folds.

Both textures are mapped by `Assets/Resources/Shaders/OneStarTriplanarPaint.shader`. RED units deliberately use the LPM paint even when an older PLANMC texture is available, preventing blue PLAN camouflage from appearing on the LPM force.
